Four images and a fully decodable six-second video exist, but planet gears are hidden, carrier plates/support pins/shafts contain empty meshes, mating surfaces intersect, and physical scale is 1,000 times the required SI size. The video has no audio, and the final project and required handoff files are missing. These artwork findings are recorded separately from the provider interruption.

Provider screening blocked further minimal quality feedback; actual delivery and quality failure are recorded separately.

officialFigures.captionZh: NVIDIA官方图：额外领域后训练在五类专门任务中的结果。Base指该领域后训练之前，增益不合并为通用分数；并非本站对本次免费端点的实测结果。

summaryZh: 11项任务保留真实结果：书架、钟表、图表、中文海报和骑车动画五项主要作品通过；其余缺少主要交付或核心质量未通过。知识视频1与4确有成片，交付存在不等于质量通过。供应商筛查另记，不作能力排名，也不宣称11件作品全部完成。
summaryEn: All eleven tasks retain their actual outcomes. Five main artworks pass: the bookshelf, clock, chart, Chinese poster and cycling animation. The others have missing main delivery or failed core quality. Videos 1 and 4 do have real encoded files; delivery is separate from quality. Provider screening is recorded separately, without a capability ranking or a claim that all eleven artworks are complete.
methodZh: creative-suite-v4，使用2026-11-04上海日期冻结题集：3项Blender、4项知识视频、3项静态SVG和1项动画。模型通过OpenRouter精确免费路由，在持久API工具会话中创作；工具是隔离shell和图像查看，工具网络禁用，并非原生Claude Code。协调者检查实际文件、独立进程测量和AI视觉观察，不替模型补作品。
methodEn: Creative-suite-v4 uses the November 4, 2026 Shanghai-date lock: three Blender tasks, four knowledge videos, three static SVGs and one animation. The model authors work through the exact OpenRouter free route in persistent API tool sessions with isolated shell/image tools and tool networking disabled; this is not native Claude Code. The coordinator checks actual files, independent-process measurements and AI visual observations without completing the model artwork.
limitationsZh: 这是TOKRACE自选的小样本创作组合，不是通用能力排名。
API标识不证明不可变checkpoint；BF16参考权重与NVFP4发布区分，免费端点精度未明确。
技术检查和AI视觉观察不等于独立真人评分；没有听审或ASR读音验收。
全部11项有明确状态，但缺交付、核心质量失败与通过严格分开。
官方图的Baseten吞吐和领域后训练条件保留，本站未复现，也不是本次免费路由跑分。
已知费用是小计，不是完整账单；缺失费用/token不填零，账户累计支出不归因本批。
limitationsEn: This small TOKRACE-selected creative suite is not a universal capability ranking.
An API identifier is not an immutable-checkpoint proof. BF16 reference weights and NVFP4 are distinct; free-endpoint precision is not established.
Technical checks and AI visual observations are not independent human scoring. No listening or ASR pronunciation review was performed.
All eleven tasks have explicit states, with missing delivery, failed core quality and acceptance kept separate.
Official Baseten throughput and domain-post-training conditions are retained; neither is independently reproduced here or measured on this free route.
Known cost is a subtotal, not a complete bill. Missing cost/tokens are not zero, and account-wide spending is not attributed to this batch.
workflowNoteZh: 作品验收与模型会话终态分开。输入筛查拒绝和媒体无法筛查两类HTTP422分别记录，不推断具体触发历史、有害内容或误判，也不把供应商拒绝直接作为能力评分。
workflowNoteEn: Artifact acceptance and model-session phase are separate. HTTP422 input-screening rejection and media-screening failure are distinguished without inferring a trigger, unsafe content or false positive, or converting provider rejection into a capability score.
usageNoteZh: 用量为已收到的归档小计，未知字段保留null。输入合并非缓存、缓存读取和缓存创建；输出已含思考token，不重复相加。完整响应计数排除error/content_filter终止。显示时间仅为已记录API请求耗时之和，不含渲染、等待和协调，不作速度排名。
usageNoteEn: Usage is the known archived subtotal; unknown fields remain null. Input combines uncached input, cache reads and cache creation. Output already includes reasoning, which is not added again. Completed responses exclude error/content_filter stops. Displayed time sums recorded API-request durations only, excluding rendering, waiting and coordination; it is not a speed ranking.
billingZh: 已知记录费用小计 $0；至少 19 次请求费用未知，完整总额未确认。仅据本批费用字段，未将账户累计支出或协调者开销归入本批。
billingEn: The known recorded cost subtotal is $0; at least 19 requests have unknown cost, so a complete total is not established. Account-wide spending and coordinator costs are not attributed to this batch.
